newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Ten injured in Russian plane emergency landing.
newsitem.headline: Ten injured in Russian plane emergency landing.

text.p: Ten people were injured, four of them badly, when a Russian military plane made an emergency landing on the Arctic Franz Joseph archipelago, a spokesman for the Emergencies Ministry in Moscow said on Tuesday.

He said the incident took place late on Monday when the An-72 transport plane with eight crew and 16 passengers on board tried to land on a makeshift snow strip to deliver a fresh shift of borderguards for Nagurskaya post.
The spokesman could not say why the plane had to make its emergency landing.
He said the four people most seriously injured, including three servicemen, had been flown by Norwegian borderguards' helicopter to hospital on the Spitsbergen archipelago, west of Franz Joseph.
The spokesman said a Russian rescue team was expected to reach the remote archipelago later on Tuesday.
